formal_statement: ∀ (n k : ℕ) (f : (Fin (n + k) → Bool) → Bool) (c : Fin k → Bool) (s : ℕ), PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.HasCircuitSize (n + k) f s → PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.HasCircuitSize n (fun y : Fin n → Bool => f (Fin.append y c)) (s + 1)
plain_statement: If f on n + k inputs has a circuit with s gates, then f with its last k inputs fixed to constants has a circuit with at most s + 1 gates (the extra gate only when the restriction is the constant true). Standard; the hardwiring step of the Murray and Williams argument (Theory of Computing 13, 2017), needed for L-meta-016.
title: Hardwiring: fixing the last k inputs of a circuit costs at most one gate
